name: agent-wars
description: Grand strategy wargame with LLM opponents — Milestone 1.1 production baseline

scripts.build: npm run generated:extract && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.test: npm run rebuild:native:node && npm run build:main && node dist/main/pathfinding.test.js && node dist/main/gameIpcHandlers.test.js && node dist/main/precomputation.test.js && node dist/main/briefingFormatter.test.js && node dist/main/callbackSubscriptions.test.js && node dist/main/callbackEvaluation.test.js && node dist/main/openRouter.matrix.test.js && node dist/main/terrainRes1Csv.test.js && node dist/main/terrainMetadataParity.test.js && node dist/main/terrainClassifierFromMetadata.test.js && node dist/main/mapData.test.js && node dist/main/gameDb.test.js && node dist/main/tools/tool1Pathfinding.test.js && node dist/main/tools/tool3CombatEstimation.test.js && node dist/main/tools/tool4Memory.test.js && node dist/main/tools/tool5StandingOrders.test.js
scripts.start: npm run generated:extract && npm run rebuild:native:electron && electron .
scripts.clean:release: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path').join(process.cwd(),'release');if(fs.existsSync(p)){try{fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,maxRetries:3,retryDelay:200});}catch(e){console.error('Release folder in use. Close the app and any tools using release/, then retry.');process.exit(1);}}"
scripts.dist:win: npm run clean:release && npm run build && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run clean:release && npm run build && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --linux
scripts.dist:mac: node -e "if (process.platform !== 'darwin') { console.error('Build for macOS is supported only on macOS. Run npm run dist:mac on a Mac. See .spec/packaging.md'); process.exit(1); }" && npm run clean:release && npm run build && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --mac
